mission: Batch A — Event Team Builder Integration. Founder-authorized: let event organizers build an event team using the existing opportunities/applications/work pipeline (no second staffing marketplace). Locked founder decisions: (1) event/opportunity organization integrity enforced server-side, not just UI-filtered; (2) staff participation stays on the professional work lifecycle — no automatic event_attendance ticket is created for staff. Scope: additive nullable opportunities.event_id column + index only; no applications/event_attendance/verifications/Passport schema changes; no RLS changes unless qa-security proves one necessary. Explicitly out of scope this batch: Passport-at-Events credentials, staff check-in, zones, Pulse, Replay, promoter reputation, Event Score, sponsor/vendor marketplace expansion, after-party relationships, festival mode, sports layer, paid ticketing/Stripe. Implementation + local QA complete; per explicit founder instruction the session stopped here for founder review — no commit, push, PR, migration apply, or release-manager pass has happened yet.
